verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an API-first product. It has official client libraries for most popular languages, a REST API covering search, hybrid retrieval and inference endpoint configuration, Query DSL and ES|QL docs, and an official MCP server. No item states that everything doable in the UI (Kibana or the Cloud console) is also available through the API, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the tested paths. missing for 10: explicit documentation of UI/API feature parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, coverage of console and project management via API, independent hands-on corroboration.
